title: Restore UPI Payment Settings, QR Code Logic, and Persistent Admin Settings

requirements.summary: Restore the 'UPI Payment Settings' card in the Admin Settings page with input field, save button, backend persistence, and pre-population of saved values
acceptanceCriteria: The Admin Settings page displays a 'UPI Payment Settings' card with a text input and a 'Save UPI' button.
Entering a UPI ID and clicking 'Save UPI' persists the value to the backend.
On revisiting the Admin Settings page, the saved UPI ID is pre-filled in the input field.
A success or error toast/message is shown after saving.

file_operations.description: Add a 'UPI Payment Settings' card section below the existing Store Slogan section. Include a labeled text input field (pre-populated with the current UPI ID from useGetUpiId query), a 'Save UPI' button that calls the useSetUpiId mutation, and display success/error toast notifications. Ensure the input shows a loading state while fetching the current value and is disabled during save operations. Use the existing card/form styling patterns from the Store Slogan section.

Add useGetUpiId query hook that calls actor.getUpiId() and caches the result with queryKey ['upiId']. Add useSetUpiId mutation hook that calls actor.setUpiId(upi) and invalidates the ['upiId'] query on success. Follow the existing query/mutation patterns in this file (e.g., useGetShopSlogan and useSetShopSlogan). Export both hooks.

requirements.summary: Dynamically fetch the saved UPI ID from the backend in BillTemplate and use it to generate the UPI QR code on every bill with fallback to default value
acceptanceCriteria: BillTemplate fetches the UPI ID from the backend before rendering the QR code.
The QR code on every bill reflects the currently saved UPI ID.
If the backend returns an empty value, the QR code uses '9708075648-1@okbizaxis' as fallback.
Changing the UPI ID in Admin Settings causes the QR code on new bills to update accordingly.

file_operations.description: Add useGetUpiId query hook call at the top of the BillTemplate component. Use the fetched UPI ID (or fallback to '9708075648-1@okbizaxis' if the value is empty or null) to dynamically construct the UPI QR code URL. Replace any hardcoded UPI ID in the QR code generation logic with the dynamic value. The QR code image should use the direct asset path 'frontend/public/assets/generated/upi-qr-code.dim_200x200.png' for the static QR image, but the actual UPI link (if generated via a URL scheme like upi://pay?pa=...) should use the live UPI ID. Ensure the component displays a loading state or placeholder while the UPI ID is being fetched.
